messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `hosted-inference` (policy: oncall-primary -> secondary -> manager). High 5xx rate observed (error rate 18% over 2m). Primary page via SMS did not deliver (SMS gateway NACK). Escalating to secondary. Paging now via voice fallback. Details: https://pd.example/services/HI123/incidents/INC-6723456789

maya: got it. i'm primary oncall. i didn't get the SMS. my phone shows no delivery. i'm switching to mobile data and will try to ack via mobile app.

sam: i'm on desktop — i see the PD notification in the console but the SMS channel failed. can someone confirm whether voice fallback went through?

pagerduty-bot: voice call attempted to secondary (jordan) at +1-555-0102, status: delivered. sms to maya status: undeliverable (carrier NACK). escalation moved to secondary at 6723456705. manager notified.

jordan: acked on call. i'm dialed into the bridge now. joining audio. :phone:

maya: i finally got the mobile push and acked on the app at 6723456720. sorry for the delay — was in a spot with flaky reception.

emma: oncall manager here. standing by. what's customer impact? any public-facing errors?

jordan: error spike coming from inference-runtime pods returning 502s for longer sequences. seeing elevated tail latency and `kv-cache` eviction logs. paging started after 5xx rate > 10% for 2 windows. customer-facing: some low-latency endpoints showing increased 4xx/5xxs, subset of requests timed out.

sam: grabbing logs now. running: ```kubectl logs -n inference -l app=runtime --tail=200 | grep -i "kv-cache" | tail -n 50```

maya: i'm scaling up the inference pool as a mitigation: `redwoodctl scale pool runtime-pool --replicas 6` — will also toggle conservative batching off for a minute to reduce queuing.

opsbot: Autoscaler triggered +2 instances at 6723456745 (policy: emergency-burst).

jordan: seeing decreased queue length after scale, but one host shows repeated kernel OOMs: `oom_reaper` logs correlate with a recent quantized model build. marking host for drain.

sam: draining host node `gpu-13` now: `kubectl drain gpu-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — moving in-progress KV cache to fallback.

maya: confirming temporary rollback: switching to previous model variant (v1.9) on the routed pool to avoid the new quantization path. command: `redwood deploy set-variant hosted-inference:v1.9 --pool runtime-pool`

jordan: after rollback and scale, 5xx rate down to 2% in the last 2m window. latency back to baseline.

emma: good. please keep the bridge open for 15m, then we'll start a short incident timeline and assign a postmortem owner.

maya: i'll own PM. notes: SMS gateway returned intermittent NACKs — seems correlated to carrier throttling during spike. we should add secondary SMS gateway or prioritize push as primary for PD. filing follow-up: DOC-6724.

sam: adding runbook note to /runbooks/pagerduty/fallbacks.md: add voice fallback thresholds and alternate SMS provider. also will add healthcheck that verifies SMS delivery for oncall rotation.

IncidentBot: Incident state updated: acknowledgment by jordan and maya; mitigation actions executed (rollback variant, scale up, node drain). Incident severity reduced to S2 at 6723456805.

opsbot: bridge will remain open until 6723457710.

jordan: closing loop — customer impact window ~ 6723456600 - 6723456780 (≈3 minutes). no escalations to manager required beyond pager duty notification.

maya: thanks team. i'll draft the postmortem and include recommendations for SMS fallback and per-region carrier testing.

emma: thanks all. please ping me if there are lingering alerts. :thumbsup:
